name: deck-rx
description: Deck RX — SDR receiver controller for Stream Deck (AM / SW / FM via SpyServer)

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('os').homedir()+'/Library/Application Support/com.elgato.StreamDeck/Plugins/com.hogehoge.deck-rx.sdPlugin';try{if(!fs.lstatSync(p).isSymbolicLink()){console.error('ERROR: Plugins entry is not a symlink! Run: ln -s $(pwd)/com.hogehoge.deck-rx.sdPlugin \"'+p+'\"');process.exit(1)}}catch(e){console.error('ERROR: Plugin not installed as symlink:',e.message);process.exit(1)}"
